notes.title: DATA_BREAK @ Steam Next Fest & Demo update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41881925/987f666af2ee615d5267a84d1106f568b1e2e80e.png[/img]

We're fashionably late, but DATA_BREAK is now part of the Steam October Next Fest. If you haven't already, give the demo a try. If you livestream it, feel free to leave a link in the comments.

For those that have already completed the demo, we'll be adding an update soon which adds new achievements and some new things, if you can find them...
